description: The status quo the shutdown analysis is measured against: Bradley Fighting Vehicle production continues at the BAE facility in York, Pennsylvania. GAO printed p. 11 reports the study's in-depth assessment of the potential costs of shutting that line down, which presupposes the cost of continuing it.
